De student kan met eenvoudige digitale e: The student can use simple digital and AI search tools to find information and adjust searches, recognise basic features and limitations, assess reliability and misinformation risks cautiously, and store, organise, update and delete files and contact details.
De student kan zelfstandig passende digi: The student can independently select digital and AI search tools, try new strategies, translate information needs into effective queries and filters, critically evaluate relevance, sources, interests and AI bias, and manage files, accounts and simple spreadsheet datasets systematically and ethically.
De student kan in complexe situaties div: The student can combine and refine digital and AI search strategies in complex situations, examine interests and AI bias, support others in evaluating sources, and collect, process, analyse and manage data transparently and ethically for informed decisions.
De student kan in zeer complexe of gespe: The student can keep abreast of emerging digital and AI search technologies in highly complex or specialised contexts, design and improve advanced search and data strategies, guide others in complex searches, manage and document large datasets carefully, and lead initiatives supporting reliable and critical information use.
De student kan met eenvoudige digitale c: The student can communicate and share information using simple digital tools and social media, respect others’ preferences and boundaries, recognise basic differences between human–human and human–machine interaction, and manage and protect a digital identity and footprint with awareness of rights, laws and participation risks.
De student kan zijn of haar digitale com: The student can adapt digital communication to purpose and context, select appropriate tools including simple AI and robot interactions, check information before sharing, participate responsibly in digital citizenship and collaboration, and manage digital identities through settings, behaviour and visibility.
De student kan in complexe situaties dig: The student can combine digital and AI communication and collaboration tools in complex contexts, adapt communication to audiences, guide others in respectful and inclusive online behaviour, and manage digital identities with legal awareness of opportunities and risks for democracy, participation and information sharing.
De student kan bij zeer complexe of nieu: The student can follow developments in digital and AI communication for novel or highly complex challenges, design and improve advanced communication and collaboration, lead digital citizenship initiatives, and advise others on complex identity, rights and responsible human–machine collaboration.
De student kan met eenvoudige digitale e: The student can create and edit basic digital content with simple digital and AI tools, adapt and combine existing content, consider accessibility and copyright, label AI-generated content appropriately, and give a computer simple symbolic instructions for a small task.
De student kan bewust en efficiënt versc: The student can deliberately and efficiently select digital and AI tools to create and adapt content to audience, format and accessibility needs, integrate text, numbers and images transparently while respecting copyright and licences, and build simple algorithms and programs using programming and machine-learning basics.
De student kan bij complexe opdrachten p: The student can combine appropriate digital and AI content tools for complex tasks, develop specialised products suited to purpose and audience, guide responsible reuse and sharing under current law, and partly automate routine tasks and complex problems while preserving human oversight and considering social impact.
De student kan in zeer complexe of gespe: The student can lead inclusive, accessible and ethical content creation in highly complex or specialised contexts, selectively use AI, design advanced integrations and visualisations, contribute to copyright and licensing policies, and lead responsible programming and AI projects including robotics and others’ learning.
De student kan zijn of haar apparaten en: The student can protect devices and data using simple measures, share personal data cautiously, recognise basic deception, identity theft, AI and payment risks, balance online and offline habits for wellbeing, and reduce environmental impact through simple data and energy choices.
De student kan up‑to‑date en alert omgaa: The student can stay alert to malware and social engineering, use privacy settings and tools, manage personal data lawfully with awareness of AI risks, set boundaries on online use and respond to harmful behaviour or deceptive design, and apply strategies to reduce environmental impact.
De student kan bij complexe vraagstukken: The student can update cybersecurity practices in complex contexts, explain cybersecurity and privacy rights, help others protect devices and data against emerging AI threats, challenge harmful behaviour and exclusion, support wellbeing and inclusion, and guide analysis and reduction of digital environmental footprints.
De student kan bij zeer complexe of maat: The student can follow technological and legal developments in cybersecurity, data ownership and privacy, guide citizen-centred protection initiatives, advise policy on privacy, wellbeing and inclusion, lead fair and safe digital environments, and develop and improve digital sustainability initiatives.
De student kan eenvoudige technische pro: The student can identify simple technical problems and try basic solutions, recognise personal digital needs, select simple technological responses, use digital tools creatively for straightforward tasks, and recognise personal competence gaps and seek support.
De student kan veelvoorkomende technisch: The student can independently identify and solve common technical problems, choose technologies suited to needs and accessibility, use digital and AI tools creatively, and plan further development of personal digital competences.
De student kan in complexe situaties tec: The student can analyse complex technical problems and needs, combine and evaluate digital and AI solutions creatively, support others in solving problems and developing competences, and critically assess technological changes and their impact.
De student kan in zeer complexe of gespe: The student can lead work on highly complex or novel digital problems, design and evaluate innovative solutions to individual and collective needs, support others’ competence development, and contribute to sustainable, inclusive and responsible technological innovation.

Informatie en gegevens vinden, beoordele: Finding, assessing and organising information and data with digital and AI tools. Dealing critically with reliability, deception and the limitations of search tools.
Digitaal communiceren en samenwerken met: Communicating and collaborating digitally with respect for others. Sharing information responsibly and engaging consciously with online participation, identity and digital footprint.
Digitale inhoud maken, bewerken en combi: Creating, editing and combining digital content, including with AI. Attention to accessibility, copyright, transparency and instructions to computers.
Apparaten, gegevens, privacy en welzijn: Protecting devices, data, privacy and well-being. Recognising digital risks and using technology consciously with attention to health and sustainability.
Digitale problemen oplossen, geschikte h: Solving digital problems, choosing suitable tools and using them creatively. Recognising your own learning needs and continuing to develop as technology changes.
De student kan met eenvoudige digitale e: With simple digital and AI search tools, the student can search for information and adjust the search query, recognise the basic features and limitations of these tools, cautiously assess results for reliability and the risk of mis- and disinformation, and simply store, organise, update and delete digital files and contact details, make backups and restore data, and structure simple data.
De student kan zelfstandig passende digi: The student can independently choose suitable digital and AI search tools and try out new search strategies, translate information needs into effective queries and filters, critically assess search results for relevance, source, interests and (AI) bias, check AI output for accuracy and limitations, and manage digital data and information carefully and ethically by systematically naming, organising, editing and storing files, folders, accounts and simple datasets in spreadsheets.
De student kan met eenvoudige digitale c: The student can use simple digital communication tools and social media to make contact and share information, collaborate digitally on a shared task with attention to different perspectives, take into account the preferences and boundaries of others, recognise basic differences between human-human and human-machine interactions, and manage and protect their digital identity and digital footprint in a simple way, with attention to basic rights, laws and risks of online participation.
De student kan zijn of haar digitale com: The student can adapt their digital communication to context and purpose, choose suitable tools and functions (including simple interactions with AI systems and robots, where questions and instructions to AI systems are formulated and refined), check information for value and accuracy before sharing it, take part actively and responsibly in digital forms of citizenship, including using digital services and exercising digital rights, take part in and organise simple digital collaboration, and manage one or more digital identities purposefully by consciously adjusting settings, behaviour and visibility.
De student kan in complexe situaties dig: In complex situations, the student can combine digital and AI communication tools and collaboration tools and keep adapting their communication to context and audience, including by systematically refining AI instructions, advise and guide others in choosing suitable tools and in respectful, inclusive and responsible online behaviour, and consciously and legally soundly manage their own and others' digital identities, with an eye for the opportunities and risks of digital technology and AI for democracy, participation and information sharing.
